Works with Creative Mode: 1.0.1 switched itself off next to it ("signature not found: LocaText"); Find now finds the game functions Creative Mode hooks and chains onto its hooks.
Finds a game function another mod has already hooked by the code behind that hook, so load order between mods matters less.
Inside a base without storage chests, Find says "This base has no storage chests to search." instead of claiming you are not in a base.
Outside a base the search field is switched off; Enter or Esc closes it.

Reported bugs fixed:
Find inactive next to Creative Mode (reported by Dacrenzio, cnrat and Bigdaddy2I42).
"Not in a base" shown in a base that has no storage chests (reported by GreeneyeDS).
